questions.de: Welches Nahrungsmittel wurde beim Bau der Chinesischen Mauer als Bindemittel für den Mörtel verwendet?
questions.en: Which foodstuff was used as a binder in the mortar when building the Great Wall of China?

timeline.labelEn: The Ming dynasty rebuilds the Great Wall north of Beijing in mortared stone and brick
timeline.labelDe: Die Ming-Dynastie erneuert die Chinesische Mauer nördlich von Peking aus vermörtelten Steinen und Ziegeln

questions.notes: The mortar was slaked lime with about 3% sticky rice, whose amylopectin makes it unusually durable. Options removed; 'Reis' also accepted.

questions.en: Which bedtime programme for children was first broadcast by East Germany's Deutscher Fernsehfunk on 22 November 1959?

timeline.labelEn: First broadcast of the children's programme Unser Sandmännchen on East German television
timeline.labelDe: Erstausstrahlung der Kindersendung Unser Sandmännchen im DDR-Fernsehen

questions.notes: Options removed. The West German Sandmännchen also started in 1959 (a few days later); the question pins the East German date to keep one answer.

questions.cardDe: Die Krawatte wurde in Kroatien erfunden. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Nach welchem Volk ist die Krawatte benannt, dessen Reiter im 17. Jahrhundert in Frankreich mit ihren Halstüchern Aufsehen erregten?
questions.en: Which people is the cravat (necktie) named after, whose horsemen caused a stir in 17th-century France with their neckerchiefs?

timeline.labelEn: Legendary parade of a Croatian cavalry regiment before Louis XIV that made the cravat fashionable
timeline.labelDe: Legendäre Parade eines kroatischen Reiterregiments vor Ludwig XIV., die die Krawatte in Mode brachte

questions.notes: The card's claim (intended 'true') is a simplification: 'cravate' comes from French 'à la cravate' (in the Croatian manner) after the neckerchiefs of Croatian soldiers, but the costume historian Ingrid Loschek notes such neckwear was not unique to them. The 1663 parade is described as a popular legend.
